_comment: Aavkar Educational Motion Studio (AEM) client registry. Everything client-specific lives here; the aem CLI and the plugin hardcode no client. Paths may use ~. protected_files are relative to the client's design_system or to the active project folder. Add a client with: aem new-client <id>.

clients.name: MergeToMaster
clients.design_system: /Volumes/T7 Red/Yuvraj Folder/Freelance Work/Joel Belton - MergeToMaster/00 - MergeToMaster Design System

P1.note: P1's HyperFrames project lives below the P1 folder.

P2.note: P2's cut is Videos and Media/RoughCut.mp4 (25/1, 3840x2160). HyperFrames project in Animations/ (pinned 0.8.139); renders through bin/r.sh (the sentinel checks them) and batches through bin/r_queue.py --detach (background: the sentinel cannot see them; run aem check-render and aem evidence on each). Delivered 15 Oct 2026 (Done/P2 - Claude Code Done.mov, each moment at its own version, v01-v06); Joel accepted it with no changes on WhatsApp, 19 Oct 2026 (reviews/joel/2026-10-19-whatsapp.md); paid 23 Oct 2026.

review_inbox.note: Export the review link's comments as CSV; aem import-review reads the header row and maps columns.

audio.summary: Joel's sound policy, read by the mergetomaster-studio skill and checked with earshot. aem does not read it. Each value names the rule it comes from.

music.policy: only where it does a job: picture with no teaching under it, a punchline set-up, a chapter mark, the one reveal; teaching dry

sources.music: J-03, E-09; policy: Yuvraj, P2, 14 Oct 2026 (O-26), an override of E-09's one bed per segment; skill references/music.md
sources.generated_sfx: Yuvraj's decision, 2026-10-19: earshot and Claude Code made SFX may be used; Joel's open question in joel-decisions.md is still unanswered; J-01, B-26 apply
sources.llm_upload: client material stays on this machine
sources.sfx_method: Yuvraj, P2, 7 Oct 2026 (O-24): 'do SFX within Animation'; the Tuan Ly P12 method
sources.masters_carry_stems: Yuvraj, P2, 14 Oct 2026 (O-25): the 390 separate cue clips disabled in Final Cut, the masters' stems shipped; an override of M-25's separate editable clips
sources.excluded_paths: Yuvraj, P2, 7 Oct 2026: P1's SFX set 'worst and not accurate'

audio.sfx_method: synthesised from each scene's own timeline tags (P2: lib/sound.js, bin/g4_schedule.mjs, bin/g4_sound.py), real recordings for keys, Return, Esc and the mouse

moments.note: Moments come from the skill's own files: visual-plan.md and shotlist.md rows (first cell the moment, columns for word IDs, job, treatment, knows before, knows after, must stay true, where the picture stops being accurate, rule IDs); else the placements of P1's kind.

review_profile.summary: Joel reviews the finished video, never individual animations. Approval, feedback and any timestamped instructions arrive on Frame.io; some feedback arrives on WhatsApp. He never sees the production process. How much he directs varies by video, and the absence of notes is itself a decision: on P1 he gave 66 timestamped notes; on P2 none, trusting the editor's judgment. P2 (no notes by his choice) drew no Frame.io comments at all: he accepted it on WhatsApp, 17 and 19 Oct 2026, with no changes and praise for the intro.

render_sentinel.note: P1 renders through bin/r.sh (full frame), bin/ra.sh (alpha .mov) and bin/renderall.sh; P2 through bin/r.sh (FORMAT=mov for alpha overlays). All write to renders/. P2's bin/r_queue.py --detach renders in the background, after the command has ended, so the sentinel never sees those renders.
